scope: Additive audit/controller contract. It does not replace or mutate the historical Stage 6 semantic versions.

invariants.media_extensibility: Use existing media_type/media_uri/media_alt_text/media_transcript/media_source_ref fields without changing question-type semantics; new media-native semantics require a versioned catalogue change.
invariants.ui_support: All 15 current types render through the generic 4-option single-choice contract; type-specific presentation may be layered without inferring type from stem text.

contracts.compatibility_contract: Lesson/subtopic must be eligible in the canonical Stage 6 compatibility matrices; CONDITIONAL requires its guardrail; NOT_SUITABLE is blocked.
contracts.ui_contract: Explicit question_type drives presentation/validation; never infer type from wording.
contracts.media_contract: Optional schema media fields may support the item; they may not create a hidden new question type.
contracts.pedagogical_goal: Isolate one grammatical form/rule with minimal irrelevant context.
contracts.stem_contract: One explicit blank; enough grammatical context for exactly one defensible option.
contracts.distractor_contract: Same grammatical slot/category; realistic near-forms, never random lexical noise.
ambiguity_guards: Do not leave person/number/tense under-specified.
Do not use multiple semantically valid completions.

contracts.pedagogical_goal: Distinguish two or more near rules/structures by their usage conditions and meaning.
contracts.stem_contract: Context must expose the decisive contrast and ask for the rule/form that fits it.
